column1: # Which vendored plugins each AI app other than Claude gets, read by install_ai_skills.py.
# Claude gets plugins whole from the marketplaces (bootstrap-plugins.sh). The other apps load
# SKILL.md folders only, so they get a plugin's skills, linked as plain skills; its commands,
# agents and hooks do not come along. The first-party skills (skills/, tools/skills/) always go.
# yes = link the plugin's skills into that app; anything else = no. Edited by hand. The first
# column is the plugin's name in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Keep the list short: every
# skill's description sits in the app's context before any work starts.
# Default of 2026-10-01: the discipline and writing plugins the Claude setup runs with.
